nodes.title: Render selections with explicit coordinate-frame status
nodes.summary: Deliver public map(selection) as one merge-green slice while retaining the legacy map_stations API unchanged for m9: derive unique stations at (provider_id, station_id) grain from the immutable series-grain _Selection in src/rivretrieve/_internal/selection.py, render every selected station without filtering or mutating the selection or packaged catalogue, treat crs == 'unknown' coordinates as EPSG:4326 only for drawing, distinguish unknown from established CRS markers by colour, and include the exact catalogue crs value in every popup. Adapt src/rivretrieve/_internal/station_map.py so the existing legacy raw five-column station frame remains renderable, export only the new map name from src/rivretrieve/__init__.py, and update tests/test_package.py's exact-public-name assertion to include this milestone's map name while preserving all public names present when the step executes; do not add or remove names owned by another milestone. Acceptance evidence in tests/test_map_stations.py must use the existing fake Folium backend to prove a ch_foen find(provider='ch_foen') selection containing 738 series renders exactly 246 unique station markers (the ref's packaged ch_foen stations.parquet has 246 rows and 246 unique station_id values), every popup states 'crs: unknown', unknown-frame and established-frame selections receive different marker colours, and both as_frame(selection) and a fresh packaged-catalogue read still report 'unknown' after rendering. Also prove map accepts only a RivRetrieve selection, does not expose bbox/provider narrowing arguments, handles an empty selection without markers, and preserves map_stations behaviour. Folium is optional and absent from the gate environment: tests at lines 179 and 190 currently skip via pytest.importorskip('folium'), while _load_folium raises MissingOptionalDependencyError when import_module('folium') fails, so no dependency installation is scheduled; marker count, popup text, colour distinction, non-narrowing, and catalogue immutability are fully observable through the fake backend, but real Folium object/HTML integration remains the pre-existing skipped evidence.
